Half Shell

Make waves at Seattle’s favorite oyster happy hour at Half Shell, just steps from Pike Place Market. Join us daily from 3pm–6pm for fresh Pacific Northwest oysters, mini-tinis, spritzes, coastal bites, and our wildly popular $2 oysters.
